# Vendored files

`sql-wasm.js` and `sql-wasm.wasm` are sql.js 1.13.0 (SQLite compiled to
WebAssembly, MIT licence, https://github.com/sql-js/sql.js), copied unchanged
from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/sql.js/1.13.0/. They are in the
repository so the progress explorer works without a network connection. KaTeX
is loaded from the same CDN; without it the page shows the TeX source.
